fullPassage:
Discovering Yourself through Challenges

"To grow into a better version of ourselves, we should not stay as we are." That was the first thing our teacher said to us on the first day of school. She wanted us to start the semester by pushing ourselves out of our comfort zones and learning more about ourselves. To help us do so, she gave us an assignment to challenge ourselves in three different ways. The three challenges could involve hobbies, exercise, our studies, or even our relationships. The important part was trying something new for each one. She told us that we should share our experiences with our classmates when we finished the challenges.

Challenge 1: Ticket for One

These days, I tend to watch movies on streaming services. However, if I go to the theater, I usually watch an action or science fiction movie with my friends or family. Those are the kinds of movies they enjoy.

Going to the theater alone was something I had never done before. So, for the first challenge, I decided to give it a try. It was nice to choose the movie and the seat on my own. I didn't have to worry about anyone else's preferences. I saw the experience as a good opportunity to watch something different, so I chose a historical drama that I had been curious about.

At first, it felt a bit awkward and lonely to sit in the theater by myself. But once the movie started, I became completely absorbed in the story. It was so satisfying just to focus on the movie itself. There was nothing to distract me! This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone. After the movie, I promised myself that I would try to make my own choices more often and enjoy more activities by myself in the future.

Challenge 2: Riding the Waves

Ever since I was a child, I've always been afraid of water. So I have never enjoyed water activities or felt comfortable while doing them. For the second challenge, I decided to try to overcome this discomfort. However, I wasn't sure what to do at first. One day, I came across a video clip of my cousin surfing at an indoor pool on social media. It looked fun, and I liked the fact that it took place in a shallow pool, not in the ocean. I messaged my cousin about it. She assured me that it wasn't too hard, so I signed up for a beginner course.

At the beginning of the lesson, it was hard just to stand up on the board. After some help from the instructor, however, I learned how to balance properly and even managed to surf a few waves! It gave me such a rush of excitement. Being in the water wasn't as bad as I had thought. While the experience didn't completely change my mind about water sports, it did help me discover my sense of adventure.

Challenge 3: A New Look

Of all the challenges I chose for myself, the third one made me the most nervous: changing my hairstyle. For many years, I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead. I had always thought it was large, and I didn't want to draw attention to it. Since I was feeling confident after the first two challenges, I went to a hair salon and talked to the stylist. He listened to my concerns and helped me find a shorter hairstyle that suited me.

The next day at school, my classmates were a bit surprised. But overall, the reactions were positive. I realized that trying a different look wasn't as difficult as I thought it would be. In fact, it made me feel more confident about myself. I didn't expect that stepping out of my comfort zone would have such a positive effect on how I felt about myself.

I learned a lot about myself through this assignment, and I found out that my classmates did, too. One of them tried new foods from different countries, while another joined a creative writing club. Through these experiences, we all realized how important it is to push ourselves to try new things. We gained different perspectives on life and had a lot of fun, too! My classmates and I even talked about setting more challenges for ourselves. There are always more things that we can discover about ourselves, and it's exciting to keep learning and growing. We never know what we're capable of until we try!

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 그것들은 그들이 즐기는 종류의 영화들이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①go: 조건절 'if I go'에서 현재시제로 정상. ❌ ②is: 주어 Those(복수)에 대한 동사는 are가 맞음. 'Those are the kinds of ~'가 올바른 표현. ✅ ③had never done: 과거 시점 이전의 경험을 나타내는 과거완료로 정상. ✅ ④to give: 'decided to give'에서 decide+to-V 구문으로 정상.
det.tip: Those(그것들) = 복수 대명사 → be동사는 are. This/That(단수) → is, These/Those(복수) → are.

det.tip: 사역동사 make/let/have + O + V원형: to를 붙이지 않는다. 'made me realize(깨닫게 했다)' ≠ made me to realize(×).

det.tip: what vs that/which: what = the thing(s) that (선행사 포함). 앞에 명사(선행사)가 있으면 that/which를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리 모두는 새로운 것을 시도하기 위해 우리 자신을 밀어붙이는 것이 얼마나 중요한지 깨달았다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①prevent(막다): 원문은 push(밀어붙이다). 새로운 것을 시도하도록 '밀어붙이는' 것이 중요하다는 맥락. prevent는 '막다'로 정반대 의미. ✅ ②perspectives(시각): 삶에 대한 다양한 관점. 원문 그대로. ✅ ③discover(발견하다): 자신에 대해 발견. 원문 그대로. ✅ ④capable(~할 수 있는): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: push(밀어붙이다) ↔ prevent(막다). 'push ourselves to try'는 '시도하도록 자신을 밀어붙이다'.

There was nothing to ④<u>attract</u> me!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나를 산만하게 할 것이 아무것도 없었다!
det.analysis: ✅ ①curious(궁금한): 궁금했던 사극을 골랐다. 원문 그대로. ✅ ②awkward(어색한): 혼자 앉는 것이 어색했다. 원문 그대로. ✅ ③absorbed(몰두한): 이야기에 완전히 몰두했다. 원문 그대로. ❌ ④attract(끌다): 원문은 distract(산만하게 하다). 영화에 집중하는 상황에서 '방해할 것이 없었다'가 맥락. attract(끌다)는 의미가 다름.
det.tip: distract(산만하게 하다) ↔ attract(끌다/매혹하다). 접두사 dis-(반대) + tract(끌다) = 주의를 딴 데로 끌다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 바다가 아닌 얕은 수영장에서 이루어진다는 사실이 마음에 들었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① deep lake
✅ ② shallow pool
❌ ③ wide river
❌ ④ rough sea
✅ shallow pool(얕은 수영장): 물을 무서워하는 글쓴이에게 '얕은' 수영장은 안심 요소. 'not in the ocean'과 대비. ❌ deep lake(깊은 호수): 물 공포증에 '깊은'은 오히려 무서움. ❌ wide river(넓은 강): 실내 수영장과 맞지 않음. ❌ rough sea(거친 바다): 'not in the ocean'과 모순.
det.tip: shallow(얕은) ↔ deep(깊은). 물을 무서워하는 사람에게 shallow pool은 심리적 안전감을 줌.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 서핑 경험이 나의 모험심을 발견하는 데 도움이 되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① sense of adventure
❌ ② fear of heights
❌ ③ love for swimming
❌ ④ talent for surfing
✅ sense of adventure(모험심): 물 공포를 극복하고 서핑을 시도한 경험 → '모험심 발견'. 수상 스포츠에 대한 생각이 완전히 바뀌지는 않았지만, 모험적 성향을 알게 됨. ❌ fear of heights(고소공포증): 글에 높이 관련 내용 없음. ❌ love for swimming(수영 사랑): 'didn't completely change my mind'에서 수영을 좋아하게 된 것은 아님. ❌ talent for surfing(서핑 재능): 첫 시도에서 재능까지는 비약.
det.tip: sense of adventure: 모험심. discover(발견하다)는 이미 가지고 있었지만 몰랐던 것을 '알게 되다'라는 뉘앙스.

To help us do so, she gave us an assignment to challenge ourselves in three different ways. The three challenges could involve hobbies, exercise, our studies, or even our relationships. The important part was trying something new for each one. She told us that we should share our experiences with our classmates when we finished the challenges.

Challenge 1: Ticket for One

These days, I tend to watch movies on streaming services. However, if I go to the theater, I usually watch an action or science fiction movie with my friends or family. Those are the kinds of movies they enjoy.

Going to the theater alone was something I had never done before. So, for the first challenge, I decided to give it a try. It was nice to choose the movie and the seat on my own. I didn't have to worry about anyone else's preferences. I saw the experience as a good opportunity to watch something different, so I chose a historical drama that I had been curious about.

At first, it felt a bit awkward and lonely to sit in the theater by myself. But once the movie started, I became completely absorbed in the story. It was so satisfying just to focus on the movie itself. There was nothing to distract me! This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone. After the movie, I promised myself that I would try to make my own choices more often and enjoy more activities by myself in the future.

Challenge 2: Riding the Waves

Ever since I was a child, I've always been afraid of water. So I have never enjoyed water activities or felt comfortable while doing them. For the second challenge, I decided to try to overcome this discomfort. However, I wasn't sure what to do at first. One day, I came across a video clip of my cousin surfing at an indoor pool on social media. It looked fun, and I liked the fact that it took place in a shallow pool, not in the ocean. I messaged my cousin about it. She assured me that it wasn't too hard, so I signed up for a beginner course.

At the beginning of the lesson, it was hard just to stand up on the board. After some help from the instructor, however, I learned how to balance properly and even managed to surf a few waves! It gave me such a rush of excitement. Being in the water wasn't as bad as I had thought. While the experience didn't completely change my mind about water sports, it did help me discover my sense of adventure.

Challenge 3: A New Look

Of all the challenges I chose for myself, the third one made me the most nervous: changing my hairstyle. For many years, I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead. I had always thought it was large, and I didn't want to draw attention to it. Since I was feeling confident after the first two challenges, I went to a hair salon and talked to the stylist. He listened to my concerns and helped me find a shorter hairstyle that suited me.

The next day at school, my classmates were a bit surprised. But overall, the reactions were positive. I realized that trying a different look wasn't as difficult as I thought it would be. In fact, it made me feel more confident about myself. I didn't expect that stepping out of my comfort zone would have such a positive effect on how I felt about myself.

I learned a lot about myself through this assignment, and I found out that my classmates did, too. One of them tried new foods from different countries, while another joined a creative writing club. Through these experiences, we all realized how important it is to push ourselves to try new things. We gained different perspectives on life and had a lot of fun, too! My classmates and I even talked about setting more challenges for ourselves. There are always more things that we can discover about ourselves, and it's exciting to keep learning and growing. We never know what we're capable of until we try!

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "We never know what we're capable of until we try!"가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.tip: capable of: ~할 수 있는, ~할 능력이 있는. 'until we try'가 조건이므로, 핵심은 '시도 → 능력 발견'.

questions.passage:
Discovering Yourself through Challenges

"To grow into a better version of ourselves, we should not stay as we are." That was the first thing our teacher said to us on the first day of school. She wanted us to start the semester by pushing ourselves out of our comfort zones and learning more about ourselves. To help us do so, she gave us an assignment to challenge ourselves in three different ways. The three challenges could involve hobbies, exercise, our studies, or even our relationships. The important part was trying something new for each one. She told us that we should share our experiences with our classmates when we finished the challenges.

Challenge 1: Ticket for One

These days, I tend to watch movies on streaming services. However, if I go to the theater, I usually watch an action or science fiction movie with my friends or family. Those are the kinds of movies <u>they</u> enjoy.

Going to the theater alone was something I had never done before. So, for the first challenge, I decided to give it a try. It was nice to choose the movie and the seat on my own. I didn't have to worry about anyone else's preferences. I saw the experience as a good opportunity to watch something different, so I chose a historical drama that I had been curious about.

At first, it felt a bit awkward and lonely to sit in the theater by myself. But once the movie started, I became completely absorbed in the story. It was so satisfying just to focus on the movie itself. There was nothing to distract me! This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone. After the movie, I promised myself that I would try to make my own choices more often and enjoy more activities by myself in the future.

Challenge 2: Riding the Waves

Ever since I was a child, I've always been afraid of water. So I have never enjoyed water activities or felt comfortable while doing them. For the second challenge, I decided to try to overcome this discomfort. However, I wasn't sure what to do at first. One day, I came across a video clip of my cousin surfing at an indoor pool on social media. It looked fun, and I liked the fact that it took place in a shallow pool, not in the ocean. I messaged my cousin about it. She assured me that it wasn't too hard, so I signed up for a beginner course.

At the beginning of the lesson, it was hard just to stand up on the board. After some help from the instructor, however, I learned how to balance properly and even managed to surf a few waves! It gave me such a rush of excitement. Being in the water wasn't as bad as I had thought. While the experience didn't completely change my mind about water sports, it did help me discover my sense of adventure.

Challenge 3: A New Look

Of all the challenges I chose for myself, the third one made me the most nervous: changing my hairstyle. For many years, I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead. I had always thought it was large, and I didn't want to draw attention to it. Since I was feeling confident after the first two challenges, I went to a hair salon and talked to the stylist. He listened to my concerns and helped me find a shorter hairstyle that suited me.

The next day at school, my classmates were a bit surprised. But overall, the reactions were positive. I realized that trying a different look wasn't as difficult as I thought it would be. In fact, it made me feel more confident about myself. I didn't expect that stepping out of my comfort zone would have such a positive effect on how I felt about myself.

I learned a lot about myself through this assignment, and I found out that my classmates did, too. One of them tried new foods from different countries, while another joined a creative writing club. Through these experiences, we all realized how important it is to push ourselves to try new things. We gained different perspectives on life and had a lot of fun, too! My classmates and I even talked about setting more challenges for ourselves. There are always more things that we can discover about ourselves, and it's exciting to keep learning and growing. We never know what we're capable of until we try!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그것들은 그들(친구들과 가족)이 즐기는 종류의 영화들이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④: 바로 앞 문장에 'with my friends or family'가 있으므로 they = 글쓴이의 친구들과 가족. 함께 영화관에 가면 '그들이 좋아하는' 장르를 본다는 맥락. ❌ ①②③: 문맥과 무관한 대상.
det.tip: 대명사 they는 보통 앞 문장의 복수 명사를 가리킨다. 'my friends or family' → they.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그것(서핑)이 바다가 아닌 얕은 수영장에서 이루어진다는 사실이 마음에 들었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: 'it took place in a shallow pool'에서 it은 '서핑 활동'을 가리킴. 앞 문장의 'surfing at an indoor pool'이 선행사. '장소에서 이루어졌다(took place)'라는 동사와 자연스럽게 연결. ❌ ②: 영상 자체가 수영장에서 '일어난' 것이 아님. ❌ ③④: 아직 언급되지 않은 내용.
det.tip: it의 선행사: 'surfing at an indoor pool'. 'took place(일어났다/개최되었다)'라는 동사의 주어로 적합한 것은 '활동(서핑)'

questions.stem:
위 글에서, 글쓴이가 오랫동안 같은 머리 모양을 유지한 이유와 관련된 신체 부위를 본문에서 찾아 **영어** 단어를 (영어로) 쓰시오.

→ __________. (1단어)

det.korean: 글쓴이는 이마(forehead)가 넓다고 걱정해서 같은 머리를 유지했다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'I had kept the same hairstyle because I had been worried about my forehead.' 이마가 크다고 생각해 주목받고 싶지 않았기 때문.
det.tip: forehead: 이마. 'had been worried about my forehead'에서 걱정의 대상이 명확히 제시됨.

questions.passage: The next day at school, my classmates were a bit surprised. But overall, the __________ (react) were positive. I realized that trying a different look wasn't as difficult as I thought it would be. In fact, it made me feel more confident about myself.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 전반적으로 반응(reactions)이 긍정적이었다.
det.analysis: react(동사: 반응하다) → reaction(명사: 반응). 관사 the + __________ + were(복수 동사)이므로 복수 명사 reactions가 정답. reaction(단수)은 were와 수 불일치.
det.tip: react(v.) → reaction(n.). the _____ were(복수)이므로 반드시 복수형 reactions.

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 빈칸에 들어갈 문장을 완성하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음)

[ this / enjoy / things / made / me / that / experience / alone / realize / doing / I / sometimes ]. (12단어) (영어로)
questions.wa: This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone

this experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone
This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone.
this experience made me realize that i sometimes enjoy doing things alone
this experience made me realize that i sometimes enjoy doing things alone.

det.korean: 이 경험은 내가 가끔 혼자 일을 하는 것을 즐긴다는 것을 깨닫게 했다.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: This experience(주어) + made(사역동사) + me(목적어) + realize(원형부정사) + that절(목적절). that절 내부: I(주어) + sometimes(빈도부사) + enjoy(동사) + doing things alone(동명사구/목적어).
det.tip: make + O + V원형: 사역동사 구문. enjoy + V-ing: enjoy 뒤에는 동명사. sometimes는 일반동사(enjoy) 앞에 위치.

questions.ans: This experience made me realize that I sometimes enjoy doing things alone
